about: Programming is my passion, and curiosity fuels my continuous growth!
introduce:
Hello, my name is Kao TzuYuan, and I am a 25-year-old responsible, curious, and quick-learning Front-end developer with two years of practical frontend development experience. I specialize in Vue.js and React ecosystems, accumulating rich and diverse project experience ranging from large-scale backend management systems to enterprise customization product development.

Throughout my career, I excel at developing complex data visualization applications and backend management systems, while possessing strong cross-functional collaboration skills. I prioritize code quality and maintainability, am proficient with various testing tools and CI/CD processes, ensuring delivered products maintain high quality and stability. Beyond technical implementation, I also possess excellent communication and coordination abilities, enabling effective collaboration with designers, product managers, backend engineers, and other team members.

From initially building my foundation through ALPHACAMP courses to continuously learning new technologies via Udemy and other platforms, I consistently maintain passion and curiosity for technology. I firmly believe that continuous learning and practice are key to becoming an excellent developer, so I actively stay updated with industry trends and apply new knowledge to real-world projects.

My goal is to become a senior frontend engineer who combines both technical excellence and product thinking. I aim not only to master frontend technologies but also to understand business requirements and user experience, transforming technical capabilities into actual business value while continuously growing and creating greater impact in the field of software engineering.
starco-content:
In this position, I independently managed enterprise customization frontend development for CDP products, designing features and planning architecture based on diverse client requirements. On the technical side, I implemented data visualization and interactive functionalities using Vue3, Element-Plus, ECharts, and other technologies, while developing internal shared components to enhance development efficiency.

To ensure code quality, I implemented tools such as SonarQube, Sentry, Vitest, and Storybook, combined with CI/CD processes to strengthen test coverage and system stability. I also collaborated with cross-functional teams including backend developers, product managers, and UI/UX designers, utilizing Asana, Notion, and Slack for task management and communication coordination to ensure smooth project delivery.
yesee-content:
During my tenure, I focused on developing and maintaining large-scale backend management systems primarily using Vue, Quasar, and TypeScript. I utilized Git for version control and frequently conducted code reviews and merges using Pull Requests.

Additionally, I participated in projects involving React, where I utilized Redux for state management to enhance application predictability and testability. In these projects, I employed Ant Design for rapid UI development and customization, improving development efficiency and UI consistency based on project requirements.
alphaCamp-content:
During this period, I gained a deep understanding of fundamental languages such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, and further honed my skills in using React to develop dynamic and efficient user interfaces. At the same time, I learned how to set up backend services using Node.js and Express.js, and I integrated a SQL database into my projects to manage data storage and retrieval.

For the final capstone project, I developed a podcast streaming platform using React. This platform integrated Spotify's OAuth login system, allowing users to easily sign in with their Spotify accounts and access personalized content. To achieve this, I thoroughly studied and implemented the OAuth 2.0 authentication process, and I used the Spotify API to fetch users' playlists, albums, and profile information. This experience not only helped me master the integration of third-party APIs but also enhanced my ability to handle authentication and security issues.
movieHub-content: MovieHub is a movie information website built with React and TypeScript, designed to provide an intuitive interface for searching and browsing movie information. The site leverages the API provided by TMDB to fetch the latest movie data, including movie details, trailers, cast information, and other movies featuring the cast.
pokemon-content:
Since childhood, I've always been drawn to Pokémon. These adorable creatures have grown up with me, like loyal friends. Their evolution journey mirrors my childhood memories, continuing to accompany me. Inspired by these fond memories, I wanted to relive those nostalgic thrills.

This project is built using the React framework, integrating with the API provided by Pokémon to fetch data. The website features search and favorite functionalities.
alphaCast-content:
This project is a creation based on the React framework, allowing users to easily explore and enjoy a variety of exciting playlists and podcasts through their Spotify account. It integrates with Spotify's API, enabling searching, favoriting, playback, and even operations like categorization and saving on these contents.

The highlight of this project lies in its rich features: you can effortlessly add, delete, modify, and query categories to organize your favorites better. Simultaneously, you can explore various playlists, view detailed information, and store your favorite playlists in your categorized collections anytime.
arcade-content:
This is a website built with Astro, showcasing a collection of games I have personally developed using various technologies and tools. Ranging from simple classic games to more challenging and innovative designs, each game offers a unique playing experience. This platform serves not only as a source of entertainment but also as an opportunity to explore and learn different development techniques. Whether you're a gaming enthusiast or a developer, you’ll find both enjoyment and inspiration here.

Each game represents my experimental space, where I invite you to discover every detail and challenge, immersing yourself in an interactive world crafted with different tools and frameworks.
